content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

NOWPayments offers 300+ cryptocurrencies, 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer account required, making it a top choice for no-KYC payments. Gumroad, on the other hand, charges 10% on every sale, making it a less attractive option for creators who want to keep more of their earnings. Other options like Lemon Squeezy and Paddle also come with fees, but NOWPayments' low fee and no-KYC policy make it the clear winner for digital creators who need a reliable payment gateway.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

NOWPayments has a strong track record of supporting restricted countries, with creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya able to use the platform with ease. Gumroad, on the other hand, has been known to block creators from certain countries, resulting in lost sales and revenue. NOWPayments' no-KYC policy and low fees make it the go-to option for creators in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments is stark, with NOWPayments charging a mere 0.5% on every sale, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921, making NOWPayments the clear winner for creators who want to keep more of their earnings. Additionally, NOWPayments' payment speed is fast, with funds deposited directly into the creator's account.
NOWPayments' low fees and no-KYC policy make it the clear winner for digital creators who need a reliable payment gateway.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
Which payment gateway does not require KYC?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Creators in restricted countries can use NOWPayments with ease, without worrying about Know-Your-Customer restrictions.

With NOWPayments' low fees and no-KYC policy, creators can focus on their business and keep more of their earnings. For more information on digital product stores with no-KYC payments, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a digital product store with no-KYC payments using NOWPayments, follow these steps: Choose a stack from the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) and deploy it on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up NOWPayments as the payment gateway and automate delivery of digital products using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Test the payment gateway and automate delivery to ensure a smooth customer experience. Finally, configure your shop's URL and add products to start selling.
